description:
## Features

### YouTube
- **Glass navigation bar:** An optional floating navigation bar, a rounded capsule with the app's own blur (Android 12 and newer; older Android gets a tinted fill), a lit rim and a highlight that moves to the selected tab (ported from Morphe). It is off by default and existing navigation bars look the same until you turn it on. The switch is "Enable glass navigation bar" in General > Navigation bar > Experimental flags.
- **Glass opacity:** Sets how see-through the capsule is.
- **Glass navigation bar size:** A dialog with a live preview for the height, the maximum width and the button spacing. Buttons that do not fit are hidden from the end, and the selected tab always stays. The preview shows your tabs right after you first turn glass on, and Reset restores the exact defaults.
- **Works with** the Navigation bar styles Default, Translucent and Transparent. It is not available with Opaque or Hide navigation bar, and the narrow buttons option is unavailable while glass is on.
- **Hide status bar:** With glass on, the status bar stays hidden when you return to the app from another app or from the miniplayer.

## Compatibility
- YouTube: **21.39.525, 21.13.164, 20.05.46** (the patch applies to all three).
- YouTube Music: **9.40.51, 9.15.51, 8.30.54** (no change).

Not device-verified: YouTube 21.13.164 and 20.05.46 at runtime, Android below 12 and Android 12-13 (Morphe notes a blur crash risk there), tablets, the offline "No connection" strip, a selected tab at the far end with overflow, and the Transparent style in the light theme.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/lavinhoque33/revanced-patches/compare/v1.32.2...v1.33.0)
